name: Congress Hall
description: The House and Senate met here. Washington's second inauguration and Adams's inauguration took place in the building.

name: Independence Hall
description: Then Pennsylvania's State House. It hosted the Supreme Court's first Philadelphia term in February 1791.

name: President's House
description: Washington and Adams lived and worked near Sixth and High Streets. High Street is now Market Street.

name: Old City Hall
description: The Supreme Court held most of its Philadelphia sessions here, beside the State House.
